label: Iran Ayatollah removed, hardliner replaces
verdict_note: Khamenei killed Feb 28 2026; Mojtaba (more hardline) succeeded Mar 9.

label: Trump assassination attempt, on his knee, ear
verdict_note: Trump shot Jul 13 2024, bullet grazed ear, knelt. Ear detail from Cioccolanti channel Mar 2024, not in this corpus.

label: Bitcoin breaks $100K barrier
verdict_note: Bitcoin crossed $100K Dec 5 2024, peaked ~$126K Oct 2025. Widely predicted target.

label: Trade wars with China, supply disruptions
verdict_note: Trump 2.0 tariffs up to 145% on China, retaliation, supply chain disruptions.

label: Byron Donalds wins FL Republican gubernatorial primary
verdict_note: Won primary.

label: Oil hits $200/barrel
verdict_note: Dubai crude topped $166 Mar 2026 during Hormuz crisis. Direction right, specific number not reached.

label: Surprise attack on Israel
verdict_note: Hamas attacked Oct 7 2023. Surprise element matched. Geographic/actor details wrong.

label: Colombia goes conservative
verdict_note: Conservative won 2026 election but not a landslide.

label: Israel 2026 election black swan / shaking
verdict_note: Mossad internal probe exists; electoral fraud allegations unproven.

label: Housing market crash (1929-style)
verdict_note: Market severely stressed. Aug 2026 headlines compared to 1929. Not a full collapse.

label: Great persecution of Christians in England/UK
verdict_note: Street preacher arrests real (Maile Apr 2026, Moodley 2024-2025). Church vandalism. Apocalyptic scale not materialized.

label: Canada Conservative Party wins majority
verdict_note: Liberals won 169-144 seats. Trudeau resignation 'prediction' made day after announcement.

label: Mike Lindell wins MN governor
verdict_note: Lindell did not run for or win MN governor. Three restatements.

label: Ilhan Omar removed from office
verdict_note: Still serving as of 2026.

label: Great Depression hits 2024-2025
verdict_note: GDP growth slowed but remained positive. No recession declared. 49 references in corpus.

label: XRP hits $10+, people become decamillionaires
verdict_note: XRP ATH was $3.65 (Jul 18 2025). Currently well below $10.

label: 1929-style stock market crash
verdict_note: No 1929-scale crash. Markets volatile but functioning. 20+ references.

label: Mass bank failures and closures
verdict_note: No widespread bank failures since SVB (Mar 2023, pre-corpus). Banking system stable.

label: Michelle Obama and Gavin Newsom run for president 2024
verdict_note: Neither ran. Harris replaced Biden. Newsom never entered.

label: Claudia Sheinbaum removed as Mexico president
verdict_note: Still president. Term through 2030.

label: Next plague kills 350 million (2025-2026)
verdict_note: No pandemic. H5N1 in animals, no mass human outbreak. Mpox contained. 50 references.

label: US launches digital dollar / CBDC
verdict_note: No CBDC launched. Trump signed EO banning a CBDC Jan 2025. Opposite direction. 49 references.

label: Turkey attacks Israel militarily
verdict_note: Rising tensions only. No Turkish attack on Israel.

label: Russia strikes Poland / NATO
verdict_note: Near-misses (stray drones) but no deliberate strike. Polish PM warned Sep 2026.

label: Cuba communist government falls
verdict_note: Severe crisis (blackouts, protests, emigration), government still holds.

label: Macron resigns or removed from office
verdict_note: Still president. Says he will serve until May 2027.

label: World War 3 breaks out in Europe
verdict_note: Russia-Ukraine ongoing, Iran conflict in Middle East. No broader European war.

label: Italy Campi Flegrei volcanic eruption
verdict_note: Seismic unrest continues. No eruption.

label: Terror attack at Paris 2024 Olympics
verdict_note: Three plots foiled by French security. No successful attack.

label: Brazil election fraud exposed
verdict_note: Lula still in power. Elections pending.

label: Kim Jong Un dies or removed
verdict_note: No confirmed reports. Health speculation since 2020, no verification.
